description: CLI tool that audits Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Hermes Agent config files for misconfigurations, token waste, security issues, and stale auth. Audit, scan, and optimize make no network calls. No API keys required. Network use is command-triggered: license activation (including reactivation), update queries to the configured npm registry and a global npm install if versions differ, optional monitor enroll/run/disable POSTs, buy opening the purchase page in your browser, and fleet SSH reads — see Data & Network Disclosure.
